Implemented scripts/delegated_grading_contracts.ts with closed, versioned (schema_version 1.0) GradingRequest and GradingJudgment JSON contracts per ADR 0001. GradingRequest carries exactly one atomic assertion, a bounded prompt, and an anonymized candidate alias/output; the alias is shape-validated (variant-<12 hex>) and separately checked to reject any configuration/verdict-leaking token (with_skill/without_skill/baseline/candidate/pass/fail/grade/verdict/winner). Both schemas are self-hashed over canonical JSON, reject unknown fields via exact key-set checks, reject non-finite/invalid-enum data, and bound every string field. validateGradingRequestBundle rejects duplicate invocation_id within a bundle; assertNoInvocationReplay rejects replay against caller-held durable state; bindJudgmentToRequest rejects any judgment whose invocation_id/request_sha256/bindings do not exactly match its claimed request (covers forged, stale, and mismatched judgments). Added 11 tests (round-trip, tamper detection, adversarial fixtures for every rejection path); full skill-creator suite 336/336 passed. Committed 863269b locally, not pushed. Unblocks ap-8di.3, ap-8di.4, ap-8di.8.

Confirmed pure filesystem inspection (no grader/Goose/credential access) via an environment-sentinel test. gradingStatus reports pending/completed/stale and next actions. Found and fixed a real blinding leak while adding adversarial coverage: prepare_grading.ts derived each GradingRequest's invocation_id/filename from the literal run path (e.g. containing 'with_skill'/'without_skill'), so a delegated grader (or anyone listing grading-requests/) could read the configuration label directly off the filename/invocation_id, defeating the blinding the schema was designed to guarantee. Fixed: invocation_id is now an opaque SHA-256-derived identifier (req-<32hex>); the human-readable run path lives only in manifest.json, never in a request payload. Added tests/test_delegated_grading_security.test.ts exercising the real prepare-grading/import-grading pipeline (not just isolated contract validators) for: least disclosure (no absolute workspace path in requests), cross-workspace substitution (request+judgment copied into an unrelated workspace rejected via stale-binding re-derivation), prompt injection (candidate output embedding fake grading instructions is caught by the existing self-referential-quote/META_GRADE rule, never laundered into a trusted pass), and hidden variant disclosure (no request field contains with_skill/without_skill/old_skill/new_skill/baseline_configuration tokens). Updated existing test_import_grading.test.ts fixtures that had (unknowingly) relied on the now-fixed leak to locate a grader's slot by filename pattern. Full suite 361/361 passed; verified live through the real full-eval scaffold -> prepare-grading pipeline that request filenames are now opaque. Committed 3fd9653, not pushed. Unblocks ap-8di.9.
